title: The mode of a data set

blocks.content: One useful thing to know about a set of data is which value shows up the most. That value has a special name: the mode.
The mode is the value that appears most often in a data set.

steps: The value 3 appears twice, more than any other.

blocks.prompt: In the data 2, 3, 3, 5, the mode is ___
blocks.explain: 3 appears most often (twice), so it is the mode.
blocks.rule: The mode is the value that appears most often.

blocks.content: To find the mode, count how many times each value appears and pick the one that appears the most.

blocks.question: The mode is the value that appears:
blocks.explain: The mode is always the most frequently appearing value.
blocks.rule: Find the mode by choosing the value that appears the most often.

blocks.content: The mode is simply the most common value. Count each one and pick the winner. Let's practise!
